title: SASSA SRD R370 Grant Guide 2026: Eligibility & How to Apply
title_zu: Umhlahlandlela we-SASSA SRD R370 Grant 2026: Ukufaneleka Nokuthi Ungafaka Kanjani Isicelo
title_xh: Isikhokelo seSibonelelo se-SASSA SRD R370 ka-2026: Ukufaneleka nendlela yokuFaka iSicelo
description: Comprehensive guide for the SASSA Social Relief of Distress (SRD) R370 grant in 2026. Learn about the new income threshold, application process, and re-application requirements.
description_zu: Umhlahlandlela ophelele wesibonelelo se-SASSA Social Relief of Distress (SRD) R370 ngo-2026. Funda mayelana nomkhawulo omusha wemali engenayo, inqubo yokufaka isicelo, nezidingo zokuphinde ufake isicelo.
description_xh: Isikhokelo esibanzi sesibonelelo se-SASSA Social Relief of Distress (SRD) R370 ngo-2026. Funda malunga nomda omtsha wengeniso, inkqubo yokufaka isicelo, kunye neemfuno zokuphinda ufake isicelo.

steps.title: Understand the 2026 Eligibility Criteria
steps.content: To qualify for the SRD R370 grant, you must be a South African citizen, refugee, asylum seeker, or special permit holder. Your monthly income must not exceed R624. You must not be receiving any other social grant, UIF, or NSFAS support.
steps.content_zu: Ukuze ufaneleke ukuthola isibonelelo se-SRD R370, kumele ube yisishayamthetho saseNingizimu Afrika, umbaleki, ofuna ukukhoseliswa, noma umnikazi wemvume ekhethekile. Imali yakho engenayo ngenyanga akumele yeqe ku-R624. Akumele ube uthola esinye isibonelelo somphakathi, i-UIF, noma uxhaso lwe-NSFAS.
steps.content_xh: Ukuze ufaneleke ukufumana isibonelelo se-SRD R370, kufuneka ube ngummi waseMzantsi Afrika, imbaleki, ofuna ukukhuselwa, okanye umnini wemvume ekhethekileyo. Ingeniso yakho yenyanga mayingadluli kwi-R624. Akufuneki ube ufumana nasiphi na esinye isibonelelo soluntu, i-UIF, okanye inkxaso ye-NSFAS.
tips: The income threshold is strictly monitored via bank verification.
Ensure your mobile number is active and RICA'd in your name.
tips_zu: Umkhawulo wemali engenayo uqashelwa kakhulu ngokuqinisekiswa kwebhange.
Qiniseka ukuthi inombolo yakho yeselula iyasebenza futhi ibhaliswe (RICA) ngegama lakho.
tips_xh: Umda wengeniso ubekwe esweni ngokungqongqo ngongqiniso lwebhanki.
Qinisekisa ukuba inombolo yakho yeselula iyasebenza kwaye i-RICA kwigama lakho.

steps.title: Submit Your Application Online
steps.content: The most efficient way to apply is via the official SASSA SRD website (srd.sassa.gov.za) or the SASSA WhatsApp line (082 046 8553). You will need your 13-digit ID number and mobile phone.
steps.content_zu: Indlela ephumelela kakhulu yokufaka isicelo kusebenzisa iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-SASSA SRD (srd.sassa.gov.za) noma inombolo ye-WhatsApp ye-SASSA (082 046 8553). Uzodinga inombolo yakho ye-ID enezinhlamvu eziyi-13 nomakhalekhukhwini wakho.
steps.content_xh: Eyona ndlela isebenzayo yokufaka isicelo kukusebenzisa iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-SASSA SRD (srd.sassa.gov.za) okanye umnxeba we-WhatsApp we-SASSA (082 046 8553). Uzofuna inombolo yakho ye-ID enamanani ali-13 kunye nemobhayili yakho.
tips: Follow the prompts carefully to provide your personal and contact details.
Double-check your banking details to avoid payment delays.
tips_zu: Landela imiyalelo ngokucophelela ukuze unikeze imininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu neyokuxhumana.
Hlola kabili imininingwane yakho yasebhange ukuze ugweme ukubambezeleka kokukhokhelwa.
tips_xh: Landela imiyalelo ngononophelo ukuze unikeze iinkcukacha zakho kunye neenkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano.
Khangela iinkcukacha zakho zebhanki ukuze ungapheli lixesha lokuhlawulwa.

title: How to Appeal a Declined SASSA SRD Application (Step-by-Step)
title_zu: Ungasidlulisa Kanjani Isicelo Se-SASSA SRD Esichithiwe (Isinyathelo Ngesinyathelo)
title_xh: Ubungasibhena Njani iSicelo se-SASSA SRD esikhatyiweyo (Inyathelo ngenyathelo)
description: Was your SASSA SRD R370 application declined? Don't lose hope. Follow our 2026 guide to lodge an appeal with the Independent Tribunal.
description_zu: Ingabe isicelo sakho se-SASSA SRD R370 sichithiwe? Ungalahli ithemba. Landela umhlahlandlela wethu ka-2026 ukuze ufake isicelo sokudlulisa icala ku-Tribunal Ezimele.
description_xh: Ngaba isicelo sakho se-SASSA SRD R370 sikhaliwe? Ungalahli ithemba. Landela isikhokelo sethu sika-2026 sokufaka isibheno kwi-Tribunal e-Independent.

steps.title: Identify the Reason for Decline
steps.content: Common reasons include 'UIF registered', 'NSFAS registered', or 'Alternative Income Source'. Check your exact reason on the status portal.
steps.content_zu: Izizathu ezivamile zihlanganisa 'obhaliswe ku-UIF', 'obhaliswe ku-NSFAS', noma 'Omunye Umthombo Wemali'. Hlola isizathu sakho esiqondile kungosi yesimo.
steps.content_xh: Izizathu eziqhelekileyo ziquka 'ubhalisiwe kwi-UIF', 'ubhalisiwe kwi-NSFAS', okanye 'Omunye uMthombo weNgeniso'. Jonga isizathu sakho esichanekileyo kwiphothali yemo.
tips: Use our status check tool to find your decline code.
tips_zu: Sebenzisa ithuluzi lethu lokuhlola isimo ukuze uthole ikhodi yakho yokuchithwa.
tips_xh: Sebenzisa isixhobo sethu sokujonga imeko ukuze ufumane ikhowudi yakho yokukhaba.

title: How to Apply for the SASSA Child Support Grant in 2026
title_zu: Ungasifaka Kanjani Isicelo Sesibonelelo Sokusekela Ingane se-SASSA ngo-2026
title_xh: Indlela yokuFaka iSicelo seSibonelelo soXhaso loMntwana se-SASSA ngo-2026
description: A detailed, step-by-step guide to applying for the SASSA Child Support Grant, including updated 2026 eligibility criteria and document requirements.
description_zu: Umhlahlandlela onemininingwane, wesinyathelo ngesinyathelo wokufaka isicelo sesibonelelo sokusekela ingane se-SASSA, kuhlanganise nemibandela yokufaneleka nezincomo zemibhalo zika-2026.
description_xh: Isikhokelo esineenkcukacha, inyathelo ngenyathelo lokufaka isicelo sesibonelelo senkxaso yabantwana sase-SASSA, kuquka iinkqubo zokufaneleka ezihlaziyiweyo zika-2026 kunye neemfuno zamaxwebhu.

steps.title: Check Your 2026 Eligibility
steps.content: The child must be under 18 and living with the primary caregiver. You must pass the means test—income thresholds have been adjusted for 2026.
steps.content_zu: Ingane kumele ibe ngaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 futhi ihlale nomnakekeli oyinhloko. Kumele uphumelele ekuhlolweni kwemali engenayo (means test) — imingcele yemali engenayo isilungiswe kabusha kuka-2026.
steps.content_xh: Umntwana kufuneka abe ngaphantsi kweminyaka eli-18 kwaye ahlale nomkhathaleli oyintloko. Kufuneka uphumelele uvavanyo lweengeniso (means test) — imida yengeniso ilungelelaniswe ngo-2026.
tips: Single caregiver income must be R5,700/month or less.
Married couples’ combined income must be R11,400/month or less.
tips_zu: Imali engenayo yomnakekeli ongashadile kumele ibe ngu-R5,700/ngenyanga noma ngaphansi.
Imali engenayo ehlanganyelwe yemibhangqwana eshadile kumele ibe ngu-R11,400/ngenyanga noma ngaphansi.
tips_xh: Ingeniso yomkhathaleli ongatshatanga mayibe yi-R5,700 ngenyanga okanye ngaphantsi.
Ingeniso edibeneyo yesibini esitshatileyo mayibe yi-R11,400 ngenyanga okanye ngaphantsi.
